sourceScope: IB Biology Guide first assessment 2025 and Hodder Biology Third Edition (2023), all ten Theme B chapters.
method: Source-locator crosswalk, before/after lesson content comparison, original causal additions to 62 B3–B4 understandings; 61 B1–B2 foundations retained. Automated structural checks do not substitute for independent specialist review, native build or browser screenshots.

classifications.complete: B1–B2 retained following structure/source/level checks; specialist approval outstanding.
classifications.corrected: B3–B4 rewritten by adding source-scoped causal teaching while retaining prior content; specialist approval outstanding.
classifications.still blocked: Content below word-depth or source/structural requirements.
